title: Can't run claude code in Github action
body:
Hey, 

We are trying to implement claude code within our Github action pipeline.
I am running a python script in the Github action that called a library. This library should run claude code on a git repo.
The problem is that I can't run Claude code one time w/ --dangerously-skip-permissions via terminal to be able to run it in a automatic way without blocking at each step.


Thanks v.m
